About our brand and products:
Furia Furniture is a modern furniture brand focused on stylish, comfortable, and high-quality pieces designed to elevate any home. We specialize in cozy, premium furniture including cloud-style couches and statement pieces that combine luxury comfort with clean, contemporary design.

What makes us different:
Our products are made for customers who want designer-inspired comfort without the traditional retail markup. We focus on quality, comfort, and a seamless shopping experience.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn commissions by promoting Furia Furniture and driving qualified sales through their unique referral links.

How to promote us:
You can promote Furia Furniture through social media content, home decor videos, lifestyle posts, blog features, product reviews, and interior design inspiration.

Other information:
We welcome creators, influencers, bloggers, and partners who are passionate about furniture, home design, and helping customers create beautiful living spaces.

Furia Furniture Affiliate Terms & Conditions

Welcome to the Furia Furniture Affiliate Program. By applying to or participating in our affiliate program, you agree to the terms below.

1. Approval or Rejection

Furia Furniture reserves the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at our sole discretion.

We may suspend or remove any affiliate from the program at any time if we believe they are violating these terms, engaging in suspicious activity, or harming the Furia Furniture brand.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes

Approved affiliates may promote Furia Furniture using their assigned affiliate link and/or approved coupon code.

Commissions are tracked through affiliate links, coupon codes, or other approved tracking methods. If a customer uses multiple affiliate links or codes, commission attribution will be determined by our tracking system.

Affiliates may not promote coupon codes that were not assigned to them or publicly approved by Furia Furniture.

3. Commissions and Payments

Affiliates earn commission based on the approved commission structure shown in their affiliate dashboard.

Commission is calculated on the order subtotal and does not include taxes, shipping, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, or other fees.

Commissions are only paid on completed, valid purchases. Orders that are refunded, canceled, fraudulent, disputed, or charged back are not eligible for commission.

Furia Furniture reserves the right to review, adjust, cancel, withhold, or reject commissions if we suspect fraud, abuse, self-referrals, coupon abuse, misleading promotion, or violation of these terms.

If a commission has already been paid and the related order is later refunded, canceled, disputed, charged back, fraudulent, or otherwise invalid, Furia Furniture may deduct the commission amount from the affiliate’s future earnings or request repayment.

4. FTC Disclosure Requirements

Affiliates must clearly and conspicuously disclose their relationship with Furia Furniture whenever promoting our products, links, discounts, coupon codes, reviews, recommendations, or any other offer connected to our affiliate program.

Disclosure is required because affiliates may receive commission or other compensation from purchases made through their links or codes.

Acceptable disclosures include clear statements such as:

“I earn commission from purchases made through this link.”

“This post contains affiliate links. I may earn a commission if you buy through my link.”

“Ad” or “Sponsored” when applicable.

Disclosures must appear before or near the affiliate link, coupon code, recommendation, review, video caption, or promotional claim. Disclosures must be easy to see, easy to understand, and not hidden in hashtags, profile bios, footers, separate pages, or behind a “more” button.

Platform disclosure tools, such as “paid partnership” labels, may be used where available, but they may not replace clear written disclosure when the relationship would otherwise be unclear to customers.

Affiliates must not make false, misleading, or unsubstantiated claims about Furia Furniture products, pricing, discounts, delivery times, product quality, comfort, availability, financing, or customer experiences.

Affiliates must not create, buy, sell, or encourage fake reviews, fake testimonials, fake engagement, fake followers, or misleading endorsements.

Failure to follow FTC disclosure rules may result in removal from the program, cancellation of unpaid commissions, and termination of the affiliate relationship.

5. Marketing Rules

Affiliates may promote Furia Furniture through approved channels such as social media, websites, blogs, email, and other legitimate marketing platforms.

Affiliates are responsible for complying with all applicable advertising, email, privacy, consumer protection, platform, and FTC endorsement disclosure rules.

Affiliates may not:

  • Make false or misleading claims about Furia Furniture products
  • Use fake discounts, fake urgency, or unauthorized promotions
  • Send spam or unsolicited messages
  • Use bots, fake traffic, fake clicks, or fraudulent activity
  • Promote Furia Furniture on adult, hateful, illegal, misleading, or low-quality websites
  • Represent themselves as Furia Furniture employees or official company accounts
  • Use Furia Furniture branding in a way that confuses customers or suggests an official partnership beyond the affiliate relationship

6. Paid Ads and Brand Bidding

Affiliates may not bid on Furia Furniture branded keywords, misspellings, or confusingly similar terms in paid ads, including but not limited to “Furia Furniture,” “Furia,” or similar brand terms.

Affiliates may not run ads that appear to be official Furia Furniture ads without written permission.

Affiliates may not use Furia Furniture’s name, logo, product images, or brand identity in paid ads in a misleading way.

7. Content and Brand Usage

Affiliates may use approved images, logos, banners, and marketing materials provided by Furia Furniture.

Affiliates may not alter Furia Furniture branding in a misleading way or use our brand assets in content that damages the reputation of the company.

Furia Furniture may request that an affiliate remove or edit content that we believe is inaccurate, misleading, non-compliant, or harmful to the brand.

8. Cookie Tracking

Our affiliate program uses cookies and/or coupon tracking to attribute referrals.

The cookie window is listed on the affiliate registration page or affiliate dashboard. If a customer disables cookies, clears cookies, uses another affiliate’s link, or tracking fails for any reason, Furia Furniture may not be able to attribute the sale.

9. Prohibited Referrals

Affiliates may not earn commission on self-referrals, fake orders, duplicate orders, test orders, or purchases made with the intent to abuse the affiliate program.

Furia Furniture reserves the right to cancel commissions connected to suspicious, fraudulent, or prohibited activity.

10. Removal from the Program

Affiliates may request removal from the program by contacting contact@furiafurniture.com.

Furia Furniture may suspend or remove affiliates at any time for violating these terms or for any activity we believe is harmful to the business.

11. Changes to the Program

Furia Furniture may update commission rates, cookie windows, payout schedules, terms, or program rules at any time.

Continued participation in the program means you accept the updated terms.
